title: Cinnamon Poached Plum Granita
changes_from_base: Plums poached with cinnamon replace the raw strawberries, and the purée is frozen in ice-cube trays and pulsed instead of scraped.
summary: A refreshing frozen dessert featuring tender plums poached with cinnamon and lemon for a bright, fruity flavour profile.

ingredients.item: ripe plums, stoned and thinly sliced

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Place 450 g sliced plums, 300 ml water, 70 g caster sugar and 1 cinnamon stick in a saucepan and bring to the boil. Simmer for about 5 min until the fruit is tender.

steps.title: Flavour
steps.text: Remove the pan from the heat and take out the cinnamon stick. Stir in 1 tbsp lemon juice and allow the mixture to cool slightly.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Transfer the mixture to a food processor and blend until it is completely smooth. Pass the liquid through a fine sieve and discard the skins.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pour the liquid into ice-cube trays and place in the freezer for at least 2 h. Once solid, you can transfer the cubes into a freezer bag.

steps.title: Process
steps.text: Place a single layer of frozen cubes into the food processor. Pulse 10-12 times until there are no large chunks remaining.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the icy mixture into chilled glasses and serve at once. Repeat the pulsing process for the remaining cubes in batches.

tips: Use the ripest plums available for the best natural sweetness and deep colour.
Pulse the cubes in small batches to ensure a consistent icy texture throughout.
Serve in pre-chilled bowls to prevent the granita from melting too quickly.
storage: Keep the frozen cubes covered in the freezer for up to 1 week and pulse them in the processor just before serving.
